This page used to hold a single long retrospective of the Data Science Center from 2017 to 2026. Its parts now live where they are maintained, so each fact has one current version. The last full version is in the [repository history](https://github.com/ucla-data-science-center/dsc-stats-reports/blob/f4b7204/dsc-retrospective-2017-2026.qmd).

| The 2017 to 2026 timeline of what was built and when capacity changed | [Research capability built](capability.qmd#sec-buildout) |
| DataSquad | [Research capability built](capability.qmd#sec-datasquad) |
| Open-science lessons and research software | [Research capability built](capability.qmd#sec-software) |

| The three research collaborations | [Research enabled](research.qmd#three-collaborations) |
| Redivis and the national voter file | [Shared investments](investments.qmd) and the history's section on governed data |
| GIS and geospatial support | [Shared investments](investments.qmd#sec-gis) |
| 3D capture and Potree | [Shared investments](investments.qmd#sec-3d) |
| UCLA Dataverse and the legacy archive holdings | [Shared investments](investments.qmd) and [Infrastructure](infrastructure.qmd) |
| Headline figures, their definitions, and sources | [Home](index.qmd) and [About](about.qmd) |
